name: LiveTradeBench
description: LiveTradeBench is a live trading environment benchmark designed to evaluate large language model agents in realistic and evolving financial markets. It tests sequential decision-making and consistency under live uncertainty by streaming live market prices and news, supporting multi-asset portfolio management, and evaluating across diverse market environments.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the live-trading/agentic finance literature, so it is not yet widely adopted but is notable for emphasizing realistic online evaluation under non-stationary market conditions.
notes: Focuses on live data streaming to avoid information leakage and evaluates multi-market trading strategies under real-time uncertainty.
